unavailableBody: We have paused this area while we fix a problem. Your data is still here — we have not touched it.

retiredBody: This area is no longer part of LifeSort. Your data is still yours — you can export or delete it under Settings.
unreleasedBody: This area has not been opened to users yet.
internalOnlyBody: This area is still being built and is not open yet.
betaOnlyBody: This area is open to a small group of testers right now.
dataSafeNote: You can always export or delete your data under Settings.
settingsDescription: Choose what LifeSort helps you with
chooseTitle: What should LifeSort help you with?
chooseSubtitle: Turn on the areas you need. You can always change this later.
